why: The T-SQsrl is a named, study-developed assessment instrument rather than a reusable instructional element.
name: T-SQsrl paired teacher and student SRL questionnaires
product_description: A paired teacher-and-student questionnaire instrument developed by Avivit Arvatz and colleagues to assess self-regulated-learning subprocesses and reflection through self-report and triangulated open-ended responses.

why: T-MITOCAR is a named automated assessment tool for diagnosing and comparing learners’ externally expressed mental models, not a general learning theory.
name: T-MITOCAR (Text-Model Inspection Trace of Concepts and Relations)
product_description: An automated computer-based assessment tool developed by Lehmann et al. that converts learners’ natural-language mental-model descriptions into concept-relation graphs and compares them with an expert reference model.

why: T-MITOCAR is a named computational-linguistic software technology rather than a general instructional element.
name: T-MITOCAR (Text-Model Inspection Trace of Concepts and Relations)
product_description: T-MITOCAR is a computational-linguistic heuristic technology developed by Inka Sara Hähnlein for automatically modeling, visualizing, and comparing the semantic knowledge structures of texts.
